Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.config

Class StripeProperties

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.config.StripeProperties
@Component @ConfigurationProperties(prefix="aihealthcare.stripe") public class StripeProperties extends Object
Configuration properties for Stripe Billing integration.

Maps the aihealthcare.stripe.* keys from application.yml into a type-safe bean. Values are typically set via environment variables:

  • STRIPE_API_KEY — Stripe secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...)
  • STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET — webhook endpoint signing secret (whsec_...)
  • STRIPE_SUBSCRIBER_PRICE_ID — Stripe Price ID for the Subscriber tier

When apiKey is blank the Stripe integration is effectively disabled; the webhook controller will reject incoming events gracefully.
